trajectory_summary: This is a short, mechanically efficient call: the rep moves through verify, bill collection, and booking in under six minutes with a cooperative customer who never resists. The rep's execution is clean on procedure but flat on engagement — verify answers are taken at face value without follow-up, and the customer's one unscripted question gets a one-line brush-off instead of a real answer.

observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day (Monday) and time (11:00) were both confirmed on the call, and the channel (phone) was explicitly selected by the customer at 03:10.

interest_reason_audit.reasoning: The rep never asks what interested the customer in solar at any point in the call; verify moves directly from address/title to utility and bill without the interest question.
